title: Exit Paradox — Anastasia Koroleva (4x exited founder) on why building again after a successful exit can be harder than the first time
summary: Anastasia Koroleva (4x exited tech founder, 9-figure first exit) hosts Eric for a 69-minute conversation on what changes when founders build after success — why the motivation that carried you the first time may not carry you again, why experience doesn't automatically become useful learning, and why founders often leave a difficult exit with a personal story that avoids changing the structures that allowed it. Chapters span Sol Price / Costco, Eric's four dimensions of governance, vanity metrics, and contribution vs status.
blockquote: Building a second company after a successful exit can look easier. You have experience, a network and financial freedom. But one of the forces that carried you through the first company may no longer be there: financial necessity. Eric Ries, author of The Lean Startup and Incorruptible, joins Anastasia Koroleva to examine what changes when founders build again after success.
